title: <root>/.musikata/<computer id>/now-playing.json: what one computer was playing (R1.8, A2.8)

saved.description: When it was written: UTC, ISO 8601

source.description: Where the queue comes from: an album's title, Songs, a folder's name

current.description: The place in songs of the song playing or cued; null when the queue has played out

songs.description: The queue in the order it plays: those before current have played

path.description: The file's path under the root, with / separators

hash.description: The audio hash of A2.3; left out when not known

added.description: Added by the user with Play next or Add to queue (R7.2)

unshuffled.description: Its place in the order shuffle off returns to (R7.3)
